description: Defines data structures and parsing logic for TalkDirective commands, including the TalkDirective struct, parsing results, and a parser utility with methods to interpret JSON-encoded directives within text.

classes.name: TalkDirective
classes.description: Represents parameters for speech directives, including voice, model, speed, and other speech synthesis settings.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParseResult
classes.description: Encapsulates the result of parsing a talk directive from text, including the parsed directive, the remaining stripped text, and any unknown keys.

classes.name: TalkDirectiveParser
classes.description: Provides static functions to parse a text string into a TalkDirective, interpreting JSON content and extracting directive parameters.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses input text to find and interpret a JSON-encoded TalkDirective within the text, returning a structured result.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Utility to retrieve a string value from a JSON dictionary given potential keys.

methods.name: doubleValue
methods.description: Utility to retrieve a Double value from a JSON dictionary given potential keys.

methods.name: intValue
methods.description: Utility to retrieve an Int value from a JSON dictionary given potential keys.

methods.name: boolValue
methods.description: Utility to retrieve a Bool value from a JSON dictionary given potential keys.
